  ## 📝 Summary
  Adds a `json_prune` plugin that strips unnecessary JSON fields from API tool responses  
  using a whitelist approach. Many REST APIs return noisy data (thumbnails, engines,      
  parsed_urls, etc.) that wastes tokens and can confuse the LLM. This plugin runs as a    
  `tool_post_invoke` hook — only fields explicitly listed in dot-notation paths are       
  retained.

  Based on the implementation proposed by @alex9434 in #2971 and discussion #2511, adapted
   to match project conventions (immutable payloads, proper logging, dual result format   
  support).
